yakguardian: @Gtgchristopher only 1 question I've had since the ARG: will it be possible to play out Ra's charge against OblivAeon with the Ennead at his side?
 
 
GTGChristopher: @Yakguardian You can play whatever story you can tell in the RPG. That's the beauty of RPGs! That said, the official story stuff we'll be doing with the RPG is going forward stuff, not moving backwards. But we'll probably be putting out "flashback" things, depending on how the RPG does.
 
yakguardian: @Gtgchristopher I meant in OblivAeon
 
GTGChristopher: @Yakguardian Sort of!

Reading through these I've decided Ronway asks the best questions and Peter asks... questions. Foote asks good ones too, really everyone does but Ronway asks the ones I'm wondering too.

Couple of interesting reveals that stood out to me:

-Dawn's cosmic power source is unrelated to OblivAeon.

-Aeon Men are created beings of OblivAeon energy

-Cosmic Contest will probably never be made

-Implied we might see Jansa and Citizen Dawn, (maybe as allies, I can see Jansa appearing in Lifeline's deck)

- A Ra promo, perhaps if we're good. Final stretch goal is six cards (perhaps promos of some of the nine heroes listed above with only one promo? If so which poor three get left out)

Edit: Its in a different thread so I'll list the nine here: Ra, ExPat, Fixer, NightMist, K.N.Y.F.E., Chrono-Ranger, Naturalist, Setback, and the Scholar
